title: Transition Essentials
outcome: Organize identity, records, and signature practices before taking the next administrative step.

steps.title: Record the signing capacity

lines.text: Signature must show unambiguously that it is made on behalf of the represented person.

speed_bumps: Do not assume a signature format changes who is obligated without reviewing the instrument and applicable law.

steps.title: Maintain a request and ledger habit

lines.text: Keep dated copies of requests, responses, account statements, and delivery confirmation.

speed_bumps: A public-records request is governed by the rules of the receiving agency and may have exemptions or fees.

steps.title: Create a records inventory

lines.text: List identity numbers, tax identifiers, mailing addresses, and the documents that use them; store the inventory securely.

speed_bumps: Limit access to identifying information and avoid sending it by unprotected email.
